sentences.text: Bonatitan was a lightly built sauropod measuring about 6 meters long, 1.5 meters high, and weighing 3 tons.
Its tail vertebrae featured uniform cavities throughout their structure.
José Bonaparte discovered the remains of Bonatitan in 1990.
Fossils were found in the Río Colorado Subgroup at Bajo Santa Rosa in Río Negro Province, Argentina.
The genus Bonatitan was named in 2004 by Martinelli and Forasiepi based on two incomplete skeletons including the base of the skull.
The type species Bonatitan reigi honors paleontologist José Fernando Bonaparte and Osvaldo Reig.
Bonatitan is classified within the family Saltasauridae.
The animal belongs to the parent group Saltasaurinae.
Bonatitan lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 83 to 65 million years ago, in the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages.
It inhabited what is now South America.
Researchers suggest there may be a sauropod taxon in the Allen Formation distinct from Bonatitan, though this remains possible evidence rather than a confirmed discovery.
